scope: four tasks, original 128 queries, clean starts, two target-matched CEM arms

practical_tolerance.criterion: AP-CEM success rate no more than 10 percentage points below publication
practical_tolerance.applies_to: gaussian_observed; final-goal CEM is reported as a paired control
practical_tolerance.control_fidelity: Report the control's signed paper difference separately

limitations: Published rates are external results; agreement is not statistical equivalence.
Original fixed queries are not new independent query or seed replication.
Preparation, engineering, failed attempts and video work need separate ledgers.
This audit checks saved physical states; it does not execute or rerun simulations.

paired_bootstrap.method: paired query bootstrap independently within task, equal task weights
paired_bootstrap.rng: Python random.Random; interval algorithm independently implemented
